module applet
  current_euid() -> Int effect
  current_exe() -> Result[Path, Error] effect
  hash_password(password: Str, algorithm: Str) -> Result[Str, Error] effect
  login_session(user: {gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}, preserve_env: Bool, host: Str) -> Result[Int, Error] effect
  mdev(argv: List[Str]) -> Result[Int, Error] effect
  su_session(user: {gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}, login: Bool, preserve_env: Bool, shell: Str, command: Str, extra_args: List[Str]) -> Result[Int, Error] effect
  sulogin_session(user: {gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}) -> Result[Int, Error] effect
  verify_password(password: Str, hash: Str) -> Bool effect

module archive
  compress(source: Path, dest: Path, format: Str = default, level: Int = default, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  cpio_create(path: Path, root: Path, entries: List[Path], overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  cpio_extract(path: Path, dest: Path, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  cpio_list(path: Path) -> Result[Stream[{kind: Str, link_name: Str, mode: Int, modified: Int, path: Path, size: Int}], Error] effect
  decompress(source: Path, dest: Path, format: Str = default, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  decompress_bytes(source: Path, format: Str = default) -> Result[Bytes, Error] effect
  tar_create(path: Path, root: Path, entries: List[Path], compression: Str = default, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  tar_extract(path: Path, dest: Path, strip_components: Int = default, compression: Str = default, overwrite: Bool = default, members: List[Path] = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  tar_list(path: Path, compression: Str = default, members: List[Path] = default) -> Result[Stream[{kind: Str, link_name: Str, mode: Int, modified: Int, path: Path, size: Int}], Error] effect
  zip_extract(path: Path, dest: Path, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  zip_list(path: Path) -> Result[Stream[{kind: Str, link_name: Str, mode: Int, modified: Int, path: Path, size: Int}], Error] effect

module bytes
  concat(chunks: List[Bytes]) -> Bytes pure
  copy(source: Path, dest: Path, block_size: Int = default, count: Int = default, skip: Int = default, seek: Int = default, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[{blocks: Int, bytes: Int}, Error] effect
  copy_file(source: Path, dest: Path, source_offset: Int = default, dest_offset: Int = default, length: Int = default, create: Bool = default, truncate: Bool = default) -> Result[{blocks: Int, bytes: Int}, Error] effect
  from_ints(values: List[Int]) -> Result[Bytes, Error] pure
  from_text(text: Str) -> Bytes pure
  human(size: Int) -> Str pure
  pack_be(value: Int, width: Int) -> Result[Bytes, Error] pure
  pack_le(value: Int, width: Int) -> Result[Bytes, Error] pure
  read_at(path: Path, offset: Int, length: Int) -> Result[Bytes, Error] effect
  unpack_be(data: Bytes, width: Int, offset: Int = default) -> Result[Int, Error] pure
  unpack_le(data: Bytes, width: Int, offset: Int = default) -> Result[Int, Error] pure
  write_at(path: Path, offset: Int, data: Bytes, create: Bool = default) -> Result[Int, Error] effect
  zero(length: Int) -> Result[Bytes, Error] pure
  zero_at(path: Path, offset: Int, length: Int, create: Bool = default) -> Result[Int, Error] effect

module cli
  applet(argv: List[Str], schema: Record, command: Str = default) -> Result[Record, Error] pure
  commands(argv: List[Str], commands: Record) -> Result[Record, Error] pure
  commands(argv: List[Str], rootless_default: Str, commands: Record, fallback_command: Record = default) -> Result[Record, Error] pure
  parse(argv: List[Str], schema: Record, command: Str = default) -> Result[Record, Error] pure
  parse_full(argv: List[Str], schema: Record, env: Record = default, command: Str = default) -> Result[Record, Error] pure
  tokens(argv: List[Str], value_flags: List[Str] = default) -> Result[List[{kind: Str, name: Str, value: Str}], Error] pure
  usage(schema: Record, command: Str = default) -> Str pure

  count() -> Int pure

module fs

  chmod(path: Path, mode: Int) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect

  copy_tree(source: Path, dest: Path, parents: Bool = default, overwrite: Bool = default, follow_symlinks: Bool = default) -> Result[{dirs: Int, files: Int, symlinks: Int}, Error] effect

  executable(path: Path) -> Result[Bool, Error] effect
  executable(mode: Int) -> Bool pure
  exists(path: Path) -> Result[Bool, Error] effect
  files(path: Path, gitignore: Bool = default, stat: Bool = default, exts: List[Str] = default, hidden: Bool = default) -> Result[Stream[{accessed: Int, blocks_512: Int, executable: Bool, ext: Str, gid: Int, group_executable: Bool, kind: Str, mode: Int, modified: Int, name: Str, other_executable: Bool, owner_executable: Bool, path: Path, setgid: Bool, setuid: Bool, size: Int, sticky: Bool, uid: Int, world_writable: Bool}], Error] effect
  filesystem_stats(path: Path) -> Result[{available_1k: Int, blocks_1k: Int, capacity_percent: Int, used_1k: Int}, Error] effect
  fsync(path: Path) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  gitroot() -> Result[Path, Error] effect
  group_executable(mode: Int) -> Bool pure
  install(source: Path, dest: Path, mode: Int, parents: Bool = default, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  install_as(source: Path, dest: Path, mode: Int, owner: {gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}, group: {gid: Int, members: List[Str], name: Str}, parents: Bool = default, overwrite: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  lock(path: Path, shared: Bool = default, nonblocking: Bool = default) -> Result[{id: Int, path: Path, shared: Bool}, Error] effect
  ls(path: Path, stat: Bool = default, ordered: Bool = default) -> Result[Stream[{accessed: Int, blocks_512: Int, executable: Bool, ext: Str, gid: Int, group_executable: Bool, kind: Str, mode: Int, modified: Int, name: Str, other_executable: Bool, owner_executable: Bool, path: Path, setgid: Bool, setuid: Bool, size: Int, sticky: Bool, uid: Int, world_writable: Bool}], Error] effect
  metadata(path: Path) -> Result[{accessed: Int, blocks_512: Int, executable: Bool, ext: Str, gid: Int, group_executable: Bool, kind: Str, mode: Int, modified: Int, name: Str, other_executable: Bool, owner_executable: Bool, path: Path, setgid: Bool, setuid: Bool, size: Int, sticky: Bool, uid: Int, world_writable: Bool}, Error] effect
  mkdir(path: Path, parents: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  mkfifo(path: Path, mode: Int) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  mount_for(path: Path) -> Result[{available_1k: Int, blocks_1k: Int, capacity_percent: Int, files: Int, files_capacity_percent: Int, files_free: Int, files_used: Int, filesystem: Str, fstype: Str, mounted_on: Path, readonly: Bool, used_1k: Int}, Error] effect
  mounts() -> Result[Stream[{available_1k: Int, blocks_1k: Int, capacity_percent: Int, files: Int, files_capacity_percent: Int, files_free: Int, files_used: Int, filesystem: Str, fstype: Str, mounted_on: Path, readonly: Bool, used_1k: Int}], Error] effect
  open_root(path: Path) -> Result[{id: Int}, Error] effect
  other_executable(mode: Int) -> Bool pure
  owner_executable(mode: Int) -> Bool pure
  project_root(kind: Str, qualifier: Str, organization: Str, application: Str) -> Result[{id: Int}, Error] effect
  read_text(path: Path) -> Result[Str, Error] effect

  list() -> Result[Stream[{argv: Str, argv0: Str, command: Str, parent_pid: Int, pid: Int, runtime_seconds: Int, start_time: Str, start_time_ms: Int, status: Str, uid: Int, user: Str}], Error] effect
  port(port: Int) -> Result[Stream[{argv: Str, argv0: Str, command: Str, fd: Int, inode: Int, local: Str, local_address: Str, local_port: Int, parent_pid: Int, pid: Int, protocol: Str, remote: Str, remote_address: Str, remote_port: Int, state: Str, uid: Int, user: Str}], Error] effect
  ports() -> Result[Stream[{argv: Str, argv0: Str, command: Str, fd: Int, inode: Int, local: Str, local_address: Str, local_port: Int, parent_pid: Int, pid: Int, protocol: Str, remote: Str, remote_address: Str, remote_port: Int, state: Str, uid: Int, user: Str}], Error] effect
  ports(pid: Int) -> Result[Stream[{argv: Str, argv0: Str, command: Str, fd: Int, inode: Int, local: Str, local_address: Str, local_port: Int, parent_pid: Int, pid: Int, protocol: Str, remote: Str, remote_address: Str, remote_port: Int, state: Str, uid: Int, user: Str}], Error] effect
  run(command: Command) -> Result[Status, ProcessError] effect
  signal(signal: Str) -> Result[{name: Str, number: Int}, Error] effect
  spawn(command: Command) -> Result[{argv: Str, command: Str, detach: Bool, ignore_hup: Bool, new_session: Bool, pid: Int}, Error] effect
  stats(pid: Int) -> Result[{rss_kb: Int, vsz_kb: Int}, Error] effect
  threads() -> Result[Stream[{argv: Str, argv0: Str, command: Str, owner_pid: Int, parent_pid: Int, pid: Int, runtime_seconds: Int, start_time: Str, start_time_ms: Int, status: Str, thread_id: Int, thread_name: Str, uid: Int, user: Str}], Error] effect
  threads(pid: Int) -> Result[Stream[{argv: Str, argv0: Str, command: Str, owner_pid: Int, parent_pid: Int, pid: Int, runtime_seconds: Int, start_time: Str, start_time_ms: Int, status: Str, thread_id: Int, thread_name: Str, uid: Int, user: Str}], Error] effect
  wait_any(handles: List[ProcessHandle]) -> Result[{index: Int, pid: Int, status: Status}, ProcessError] effect
  wait_ready(handles: List[ProcessHandle]) -> Result[List[{index: Int, pid: Int, status: Status}], ProcessError] effect
  which(name: Str) -> Result[Path, Error] effect

module record
  require(record: Record, required: Record, optional: Record = default, source: Path = default) -> Result[Record, Error] effect

module regex
  compile(pattern: Str) -> Result[Regex, Error] pure

module set
  add(set: Map[Bool], item: Str) -> Map[Bool] pure
  empty() -> Map[Bool] pure
  from(items: List[Str]) -> Map[Bool] pure
  has(set: Map[Bool], item: Str) -> Bool pure
  remove(set: Map[Bool], item: Str) -> Map[Bool] pure

module shlex
  join(argv: List[Str]) -> Str pure
  quote(value: Str) -> Str pure

module system
  hostname() -> Result[Str, Error] effect
  memory() -> Result[{available: Int, free: Int, swap_free: Int, swap_total: Int, total: Int}, Error] effect
  os_release() -> Result[{id: Str, name: Str, pretty_name: Str, version: Str, version_id: Str}, Error] effect
  uname() -> Result[{machine: Str, nodename: Str, release: Str, sysname: Str, version: Str}, Error] effect

module test
  calls(ctx: {file: Path, name: Str, temp_root: Path}, op: Str = default) -> List[{args: Record, op: Str}] effect
  contains(haystack: Any, needle: Any, message: Str = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] pure
  eq(left: Any, right: Any, message: Str = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] pure
  error_kind(value: Any, kind: Str, message: Str = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] pure
  fail(message: Str = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] pure
  mock(ctx: {file: Path, name: Str, temp_root: Path}, op: Str, matcher: Record, result: Any, times: Int = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  ne(left: Any, right: Any, message: Str = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] pure
  ok(condition: Bool, message: Str = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] pure
  skip(message: Str = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] pure
  temp_dir(ctx: {file: Path, name: Str, temp_root: Path}, name: Str = default) -> Result[Path, Error] effect
  temp_file(ctx: {file: Path, name: Str, temp_root: Path}, name: Str = default, contents: Bytes = default) -> Result[Path, Error] effect
  temp_path(ctx: {file: Path, name: Str, temp_root: Path}, name: Str = default) -> Path effect

module time
  duration_compact(seconds: Int) -> Str pure
  format(epoch_ms: Int, format: Str, utc: Bool = default) -> Result[Str, Error] effect
  measure(command: Command, quiet: Bool = default) -> Result[{duration_ms: Int, status: Status, system_ns: Int, user_ns: Int, wall_ns: Int}, Error] effect
  millis(ms: Int) -> Duration pure
  now() -> Int effect
  seconds(seconds: Int) -> Duration pure
  sleep(duration: Duration) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect

module tui
  blue() -> Str pure
  bold() -> Str pure
  clear() -> Str pure
  cyan() -> Str pure
  dim() -> Str pure
  erase_line() -> Str pure
  gray() -> Str pure
  green() -> Str pure
  hide_cursor() -> Str pure
  home() -> Str pure
  left_pad(text: Str, width: Int) -> Str pure
  magenta() -> Str pure
  read_secret(prompt: Str) -> Result[Str, Error] effect
  red() -> Str pure
  reset() -> Str pure
  right_pad(text: Str, width: Int) -> Str pure
  show_cursor() -> Str pure
  white() -> Str pure
  yellow() -> Str pure

module unix
  exec(command: Command) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  id() -> Result[{egid: Int, euid: Int, gid: Int, groups: List[{gid: Int, name: Str}], uid: Int}, Error] effect
  kill_all(name: Str, signal: Str = default) -> Result[{matched: Int, signaled: Int}, Error] effect
  kill_process_group(pid: Int, signal: Str) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  notify_close(fd: Int) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  notify_ready(fd: Int) -> Result[Bool, Error] effect
  pid1_setup(signals: List[Str], subreaper: Bool = default, allow_non_pid1: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  reap_child_events() -> Result[Stream[{pid: Int, status: Status}], Error] effect
  set_hostname(hostname: Str) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  set_tty_attrs(attrs: Record, fd: Int = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect
  shutdown_process_groups(groups: List[Int], term_timeout: Duration, kill_timeout: Duration = default) -> Result[{kill_sent: Int, reaped: List[{pid: Int, status: Status}], remaining: List[Int], term_sent: Int}, Error] effect
  spawn_logged_process_group(command: Command, logger: Command) -> Result[{argv: List[Str], command: Str, detach: Bool, ignore_hup: Bool, log_pid: Int, new_session: Bool, pid: Int}, Error] effect
  spawn_process_group(command: Command, notify: Bool = default) -> Result[{argv: List[Str], command: Str, detach: Bool, ignore_hup: Bool, new_session: Bool, notify_fd: Int, pid: Int}, Error] effect
  spawn_process_group_log(command: Command, log: Path, notify: Bool = default) -> Result[{argv: List[Str], command: Str, detach: Bool, ignore_hup: Bool, new_session: Bool, notify_fd: Int, pid: Int}, Error] effect
  spawn_with_tty(command: Command, tty: Str) -> Result[{argv: List[Str], command: Str, detach: Bool, ignore_hup: Bool, new_session: Bool, notify_fd: Int, pid: Int}, Error] effect
  tty() -> Result[Str, Error] effect
  tty_attrs(fd: Int = default) -> Result[{cflag: Int, control_chars: List[Int], crnl: Bool, echo: Bool, iflag: Int, ispeed: Int, lflag: Int, oflag: Int, ospeed: Int, raw: Bool}, Error] effect
  uptime_seconds() -> Result[Int, Error] effect
  wait_pid1_event(timeout: Duration = default) -> Result[{children: List[{pid: Int, status: Status}], kind: Str, signal: Str}, Error] effect

module user
  add(name: Str, uid: Int = default, gid: Int = default, home: Path = default, shell: Path = default, gecos: Str = default) -> Result[{gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}, Error] effect
  by_uid(uid: Int) -> Result[{gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}, Error] effect
  current() -> Result[{gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}, Error] effect
  lookup(name: Str) -> Result[{gid: Int, home: Path, name: Str, shell: Str, uid: Int}, Error] effect
  remove(name: Str, remove_home: Bool = default) -> Result[Unit, Error] effect

module utils
  cache(fn: Any, args: List[Any] = default) -> Any effect
